name: Stick Shoulder Abduction

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Shoulder Active-Assisted Range of Motion Protocol

steps: Stand tall holding a stick or cane horizontally in front of you with both hands.
Grip the ends of the stick with your palms facing forward or down.
Using your unaffected arm, push the stick sideways across your body to push your affected arm outward and upward away from your side in the frontal plane.
Continue lifting your affected arm out to the side until you reach comfortable stretching tension (aiming for shoulder height or as cleared).
Hold for 3 to 5 seconds at the top of the assisted abduction.
Slowly lower the stick back down to the center position.
coaching_cues: Do not hike your shoulder toward your ear; keep your scapula depressed and stable.
Keep your torso upright without leaning to the opposite side.
Use your unaffected arm to do the lifting work; keep your recovering shoulder relaxed.
